events.body: BP-8664 (glazed ham joint, two desserts, chilled) is picked and will be packed for dispatch 22 Dec for express delivery 23 Dec, as paid. Chilled boxes are packed to the delivery date. This one cannot go out for a later date as packed, and after the holiday we would need the customer's say-so to send it at all.

Holiday capacity rebalance. The following express chilled bookings for 23 Dec have been moved to 30 Dec: DL-4796, DL-3106, DL-5178, DL-3830, DL-6940. Customer notification: not yet sent, template pending.

Further to the rebalance notice. A moved 23 Dec booking can be reinstated only while 23 Dec van space remains, and only if the request reaches Corvane on Dispatch chat marked HOLIDAY REINSTATE before 12:00 on 22 Dec. Requests sent to the email queue are worked in two working days and will miss it. Corvane decides each request. No desk may confirm a date or a time of day to a customer.

Call note. Customer rang to confirm her 23 Dec delivery for BP-8664. Advised the booking now shows 30 Dec. Customer had not been told. Customer asked for the express charge back. Advised that refunds are decided by Refunds team once the delivery outcome is known.

The THIRTIETH. I have just been told, because I rang, because I happened to check, that the ham and the puddings I paid EXTRA to have here on the 23rd are now coming on the 30th. Six days after the dinner they are for. Eleven people at my table. Nobody emailed. Nobody texted. Nothing. I'd have been stood at the window on Wednesday like a fool. I want it in writing within the hour that it arrives on the 23rd before noon, and I want the express charge refunded whatever happens. And do NOT send me 'we apologise for any inconvenience, your new delivery date is 30 December'. I mean it.
